notes.title: Update 1.5 - UI update & balancing
notes.notes:
Here is an update to rework the user interface, balance some game mods and fix bugs, enjoy!

[h2]UI[/h2]
Reworked background menu
Reworked some UI
Improved text lisibility

[h2]Ninja mode[/h2]
Increased detection size 
Visual effect of detection light reworked

[h2]Laser mode[/h2]
Added sound on lasers
Visual effect of lasers reworked

[h2]Item mode[/h2]
Increased time spawn from 10s to 20s
Reworked item spawn probability

[h2]General fix[/h2]
Default npc count changed from 20 to 30
Default round count changed from 10 to 5



Happy New Year everyone !

notes.title: Update 1.4 - Happy New Map !
notes.notes:
[h2]Map Garden of loves[/h2]
To celebrate 2023, here is the first new map of the game! This map contains obstacles which will make the games very different.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40520528/7e195aa3405af0bba61b6aa963b6b7ac20adec97.png[/img]

[h2]Gameplay changes[/h2]
NPCs can now run and make your suspicions wrong!
To enable/disable this option, go to the game settings (in selection player menu).

[h2]Interface[/h2]
new UI to choose a map when selecting players.

[h2]Correction[/h2]
Improved controller detection with Steam Remote Play Together.
Fixed minor bugs

Happy New Year everyone !

notes.title: Update 1.3 - Drones are in !
notes.notes:
[h2]New game mode : Drones[/h2]
Police drones are chasing you down ! Avoid them before getting spotted.
To escape a drone, be out of its range for few seconds or use a smoke bomb !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40520528/fe0c821b2c8486e07dd4756dae5ea41c80890132.png[/img]

[h2]Gameplay changes[/h2]
Increased sprint duration
Reduced sprint recovery

[h2]User Interface[/h2]
Added information on game options
Added visual effects in the interface
Added two new music

[h2]Fix[/h2]
Translations correction
Fixed visual effect on resurrections

notes.title: Update 1.2 - New mode and more !
notes.notes:
[h2]New game mode : Resurrection[/h2]
In this game mode, players come back to life in the body of an AI.
Resurrection is no longer possible once all AIs are dead.
In addition, an AI is executed every 5 seconds. This should raise the pressure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40520528/e5e3c6c879961c8013231ea26de57493d1cb7954.png[/img]


[h2]List of assassinations[/h2]
When a player is killed, a list in the interface lets you know who killed them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40520528/046f8be84f3ba1a1a9045b486372e168ba5dcae8.png[/img]

[h2] Fireworks [/h2]
At the end of the game, celebrate your victory with a pretty fireworks :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40520528/f3e5b847ad937e79cd464f9591854692f8ff34e7.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Tournament customization and gore option
notes.notes:
[h2]Customizable tournament[/h2]
You can now customize tournaments by selecting the available game modes.
Go to Play > Game settings, select a game mode and set the "Activated for tournaments" option.

[h2]Gore option[/h2]
Blood and dismemberments can be turn ON / OFF using the "Gore" option in Settings.
